heading: Ailanthus trees prohibited
lead: Ailanthus trees shall not be purchased for, or planted in, the public grounds.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 816240:102.R.S. § 1830. The word “ailanthus” is substituted for “ailantus” to correct an error in the source provision.
